title: Design System: vcore
status: Proposed on 2026-11-27. Recorded from the design proposal's prototype, kept outside the repository. Not yet accepted by the owner and not yet applied to src/.

headline.purpose: The page's answer sentence, or the subject's name on a brand page. One per page. 1.4375rem at 640px and under.

figure.purpose: The three counts under the headline, with tabular figures. 1.1875rem at 640px and under.

title.purpose: A card's answer sentence and section headings.

body.purpose: Running text, names in lists, top bar destinations.

label.purpose: Buttons, segmented controls, chips, table cells, legends, notes.

caption.purpose: Control captions, table headings, source lines, rank moves, hints.

plate.purpose: The wordmark only: tracked capitals in Geist Mono.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Cards, count tiles and editor panes at rest, light theme.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Menus, search results, chart tooltips, the toast, the phone's edit button, light theme.

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: A pressed count tile and the chosen card in the editor, with an ink border. A state marker, not depth. In the dark theme the ring is the dark theme's ink.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The settings sheet that rises from the bottom edge at 900px and under.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, edge, text colour and shadow changes on controls and links.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The curve for the recount fade and the settings sheet.

motion.name: recount
motion.purpose: Cards and count tiles when the scope bar recounts the page.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: The phone's settings sheet sliding in and out.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: With reduced motion set, every transition and animation is off.

layout.name: column
layout.purpose: The centred page column, with a 16px gutter.

layout.name: touch-target
layout.purpose: The height of controls at 640px and under.

seriesChecks.light: Passed a colour-blind separation check on all pairs. Every colour is at least 3:1 against the card.
seriesChecks.dark: Passed separation. Four of the eight colours sit slightly outside that checker's lightness band on the dark card and are to be re-stepped when the charts are built. Every colour is at least 3:1 against the card.
seriesChecks.text: Every text token passes 4.5:1. Quiet ink measured 4.68:1 to 5.33:1 in light and 5.86:1 to 7.66:1 in dark.

narrative.northStar: A canvas someone started for you
narrative.overview:
Every page is a set of cards that answer to the visitor. One bar says what the whole page counts and for which month, and each card states its answer and then offers its own controls, so any block can be asked another way where it stands. The look is stock shadcn/ui, which the owner pinned ("I also like the look of how https://ui.shadcn.com/ looks with graphs"): Geist, neutral greys with black as the primary, white cards with a soft edge. Geist is therefore deliberate, not a default.

The interface is grey and black so that the data can be the only colour. A series colour means a value in the data and nothing else. Direction is a small drawn arrow in ink. Words about the data are generated from templates and say what the figures show, never why.

Density is that of a working dashboard: 15px body text, 13px labels, compact controls at desktop width, and 44px touch targets at phone width. The one mark of its own is the wordmark, set as a New Zealand number plate.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral greys and black for everything that is not data.
Eight series colours per theme, used only for values in the data.
One typeface, Geist, with Geist Mono for the plate and for figures in chart tooltips.
White cards (14px radius) with a 1px edge and a faint shadow, on a near-white page.
Every card carries its own controls, its answer as a sentence, its evidence, and its source.
Selected means filled with ink; unavailable means a dashed edge and a one-line reason.
Light and dark themes, and a layout that holds at 320px wide.

rules.name: The Colour Is Data Rule
rules.body: A hue appears only where it stands for a value in the data: a line, a bar, a legend swatch. Controls, states, links, headings and emphasis are grey or ink.

rules.name: The Arrow In Ink Rule
rules.body: Direction is a small filled triangle in the text colour beside the figure, with "up" or "down" for screen readers. A rise is never green and a fall is never red.

rules.name: The One Colour Per Value Rule
rules.body: A value keeps its series slot across every card on a page and across pages. Removing a series does not recolour the others.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can sit in a column or change in place uses tabular figures: counts, percentages, ranks, table cells, axis text.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, labels and buttons are sentence case with no added tracking. The plate is the only tracked capitals in the system.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest gets the resting shadow or none. Only something that floats over the page gets the floating shadow. No third level, no coloured shadow, no glow.

dos: Do open every card with its own controls, then its answer as a sentence, then the evidence, then the source line.
Do keep hue for data. Use ink for selected, the control edge for available, and a dashed edge for unavailable or empty.
Do show direction with the drawn arrow in the text colour, with "up" or "down" for screen readers.
Do give a value the same series colour on every card and every page.
Do use tabular figures for every number that sits in a column or changes in place.
Do make controls 44px high at 640px and under, and keep the layout whole at 320px.
Do build both themes from the tokens, and recheck series colours against the card in each theme (3:1 at least) and text against its background (4.5:1 at least).
Do show a chart type that does not fit as a dashed, quiet tile with a one-line reason.
Do take every sentence about the data from a template, and make it state what the chart beneath it draws.
Do serve Geist and Geist Mono from the site itself.
donts: Don't use green and red, or any hue, to show a rise or a fall.
Don't colour a control, a link, a heading or a state with a series colour.
Don't add a seventh chart shape, or draw a shape the rule table says does not fit.
Don't let a curve overshoot: no smoothing that rises above or dips below the data points.
Don't add a third shadow level, a coloured shadow or a glow.
Don't set labels in tracked capitals. The plate is the only one.
Don't load fonts, scripts or anything else from a third party on the site.
Don't write a sentence about the data by hand, or one that says why.
Don't treat the dark series set as settled before it is re-stepped.
Don't use the Motor Trade Association's colours, logo or wording.
